title.narrative: Integrating Advanced Technology for Socio-Economic Development

description.narrative: This project seeks to establish an effective rapid response system to reduce human–wildlife conflict and protect lives, livelihoods, and socio-economic gain. The system will strengthen patrol coverage and enable real-time wildlife detection and incident reporting, generating timely data that can also be used to strengthen wildlife management, governance, and socio-economic activities including tourism. A performance visualization platform will compile and translate field-collected data into clear, accessible insights for the public and management use. The system will be installed at Makao Wildlife Management Area (WMA) covering approximately 769km², which has been selected as a pilot site due to its strategic location adjacent to key protected areas of Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Serengeti National Park, and Maswa Game Reserve.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
